g.text: Paper (title + abstract)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Abnormalities in gray matter volume in patients with borderline personality

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: disorder and their relation to lifetime depression: A VBM study

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Structural imaging

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: studies of borderline personality disorder (BPD) have found regions of reduced cortical

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: volume, but these have varied considerably across studies. Reduced hippocampus and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: amygdala volume have also been a regular finding in studies using conventional

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: volumetric measurement. How far comorbid major depression, which is common in BPD

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and can also affect in brain structure, influences the findings is not clear. Seventy-six

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: women with BPD and 76 matched controls were examined using whole-brain voxel-based

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: morphometry (VBM). The hippocampus and amygdala were also measured, using both

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: conventional volume measurement and VBM within a mask restricted to these two

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: subcortical structures. Lifetime history of major depression was assessed using structured

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: psychiatric interview. At a threshold of p = 0.05 corrected, the BPD patients showed

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: clusters of volume reduction in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex bilaterally and in the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: pregenual/subgenual medial frontal cortex. There was no evidence of volume reductions

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: in the hippocampus or amygdala, either on conventional volumetry or using VBM masked

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to these regions. Instead there was evidence of right-sided enlargement of these

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: structures. No significant structural differences were found between patients with and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: without lifetime major depression. According to this study, BPD is characterized by a

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: restricted pattern of cortical volume reduction involving the dorsolateral frontal cortex

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and the medial frontal cortex, both areas of potential relevance for the clinical features of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the disorder. Previous findings concerning reduced hippocampus and amygdala volume

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: in the disorder are not supported. Brain structural findings in BPD do not appear to be

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: explainable on the basis of history of associated lifetime major depression.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: [REGION]Posterior

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Cingulate Cortex

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Commonly

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: engaged during

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: decision-making and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: self-regulation, this region is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: often tied to the integration

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of internal and external

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: information. It is associated

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: with control over behavior

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and the evaluation of one's

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: own actions. Its activity tends

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to support the coordination

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: between cognition and action.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: It is generally described as

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: supporting self-directed

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: behavior.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Paper (title + abstract)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Changes in BOLD variability are linked to the development of variable

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: response inhibition

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Research on the development of response inhibition in humans

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: has focused almost exclusively on average stopping performance. The development of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: intra-individual variability in stopping performance and its underlying neural circuitry

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: has remained largely unstudied, even though understanding variability is of core

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: importance for understanding development. In a total sample of 45 participants (19

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: children aged 10–12 years and 26 adults aged 18–26 years) of either sex we aimed to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: identify age-related changes in intra-individual response inhibition performance and its

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: underlying brain signal variability. While there was no difference in average stopping

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: performance between children and adults, stop signal latencies for the children were

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: more variable. Further, brain signal variability during successful stopping was

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: significantly higher in adults compared to children, especially in bilateral thalamus, but

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: also across regions of the inhibition network. Finally, brain signal variability was

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: significantly associated with stopping performance behavioral variability in adults.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Together these results indicate that variability in stopping performance decreases,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: whereas neural variability in the inhibition network increases, from childhood to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: adulthood. Future work will need to assess whether developmental changes in neural

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: variability drive those in behavioral variability. In sum, both, neural and behavioral

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: variability indices might be a more sensitive measure of developmental differences in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: response inhibition compared to the standard average-based measurements.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: [REGION]Middle Temporal

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Gyrus

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The middle temporal

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: gyrus is a large, deep region in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the temporal lobe. It is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: commonly linked with semantic

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: content, meaning, and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: conceptual understanding. In

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: fMRI interpretation, this region

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: is often described as supporting

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: integration of meaning-related

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: information.
